data.question: Is this really free?
data.answer: Yes. Completely free, no credit card required.

data.question: What is the search escalation ladder?
data.answer: The order in which to reach for search tools, from the cheapest to the most powerful, depending on what you remember: the quick switcher for a title, Search for a phrase, properties and Bases for a date or a status, backlinks and the graph for a related note, and semantic search or an AI agent when you only remember the idea.

data.question: How is this different from The Obsidian Search Handbook?
data.answer: This is a short reference. [The Obsidian Search Handbook](/product/obsidian-search-handbook) is the full ebook (254 pages) with the whole method, exercises and, in the Complete edition, a starter pack and worksheets.

data.question: Does it work with any vault?
data.answer: Yes. The cheat sheet applies to any Obsidian vault.
